current_activity: Two regiments of the 559th Volksgrenadier Division attack Combat Command B near Château-Salins from Morhange
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 5 p. 236: "Rundstedt took the 559th VG Division from the sector north of Metz and assembled it at Morhange, with the 106th Panzer Brigade in support"; "Two regiments of the 559th VG Division attacked on three sides of the CCB perimeter in a mounting melee". Event definition: the attack of 24 September; the assembly at Morhange came before it. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Château-Salins with a precision of 10 km, the town the attack came from and near which CCB was concentrated. Location approximate: the point of the attack. Location support: CMH names the town and Morhange. Commander: General Muehlen. Opponents: US 4th Armored Division CCB, 35th Infantry Division.

current_activity: The 559th Volksgrenadier Division attacks down the Chambrey-Pettoncourt road toward Moncel
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 5 p. 246: "The 559th VG Division and 106th Panzer Brigade launched their attack on the morning of 27 September as scheduled"; the 2d Battalion of the 1127th Regiment (559th VG Division) "led off in an attack down the Chambrey-Pettoncourt road". Event definition: the attack of 27 September; it failed against the 35th Infantry Division. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Château-Salins with a precision of 10 km; the attack area lies east of it and CMH gives no coordinate. Location approximate: a sector point. Location support: CMH names the road and the objective. Commander: General Muehlen. Opponents: US 35th Infantry Division.

current_activity: The 559th Volksgrenadier Division is ejected from Château-Salins by the US 104th Infantry
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 7 p. 323: "On 9 November the troops from the 559th VG Division which were holding Château-Salins were ejected by the 104th". Event definition: the day of the ejection, 9 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Château-Salins with a precision of 5 km, named in the passage. Location approximate: a town point. Location support: CMH names Château-Salins. Commander: General Muehlen. Opponents: US XII Corps (26th Infantry Division, 104th Infantry).
